title: How a Small Bar Battled to Survive the Coronavirus

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Across the country, nearly 100,000 small businesses have now shut down permanently because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，由于疫情，近10万家小企业现已永久倒闭。

sentences.en: Federal relief funding has stalled, and yet some cities are now preparing for a second round of shutdowns today.
sentences.zh: 联邦救济资金陷入停滞，然而一些城市今天正在准备实施第二轮停业。

sentences.en: For the past six months, my colleague Jack Nickus has been documenting the experience of a single neighborhood bar in the Bay Area of California to understand the consequences
sentences.zh: 在过去的六个月里，我的同事杰克·尼库斯一直在记录加州湾区一家社区酒吧的经历，以了解这些后果

sentences.en: for its owner, bartender, and cleaner.
sentences.zh: 对它的老板、酒保和清洁工意味着什么。

sentences.en: Tuesday, October 6th.
sentences.zh: 10月6日，星期二。

sentences.en: Jack, tell me about The Hatch.
sentences.zh: 杰克，跟我讲讲“小木屋”（The Hatch）吧。

sentences.en: So The Hatch is the classic neighborhood bar.
sentences.zh: “小木屋”就是那种典型的社区酒吧。

sentences.en: I moved to Oakland in late 2015, and one of the first things you do when you move to a new city is you find your local dive bar.
sentences.zh: 我在2015年底搬到奥克兰，当你搬到一个新城市时，你做的第一件事之一就是找你当地的潜水酒吧（小酒馆）。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: At least if you're me.
sentences.zh: 至少如果你像我一样的话。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, I knew it would be The Hatch.
sentences.zh: 很快我就知道，这家店会是“小木屋”。

sentences.en: It's just a really perfect neighborhood bar in my view.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，它简直是一家完美的社区酒吧。

sentences.en: It's unpretentious, relaxed.
sentences.zh: 它不加掩饰、轻松惬意。

sentences.en: The beer is cheap.
sentences.zh: 啤酒很便宜。

sentences.en: You can always find a seat.
sentences.zh: 你总能找到座位。

sentences.en: And I ended up just spending a lot of time there.
sentences.zh: 最后我只是在那里花了很多时间。

sentences.en: You know, my friends and I would gather around uneven tables upstairs and spend long nights talking until close.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我和我的朋友们会聚在楼上高低不平的桌子旁，度过漫长的夜晚，聊天直到打烊。

sentences.en: And we'd watch the NBA playoffs on a bedsheet that hung from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 我们会在从天花板上垂下来的床单上看NBA季后赛。

sentences.en: And we just, uh, we made it our place.
sentences.zh: 我们只是，呃，把它当成了我们的地方。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us here on Mornings on 2.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收看“2号台早间新闻”。

sentences.en: It is Tuesday, March 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: Bars, nightclubs, and restaurants closed at midnight.
sentences.zh: 酒吧、夜总会和餐馆已在午夜关闭。

sentences.en: So when the pandemic hit, and I realized that small businesses across the country were going to close, my mind went to The Hatch.
sentences.zh: 所以当疫情来袭，我意识到全国各地的小企业都要关门时，我的脑海里就浮现出了“小木屋”。

sentences.en: And I decided, let me follow this place for a few months and see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我决定，让我关注这个地方几个月，看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: And so I check in on The Hatch on March 17th.
sentences.zh: 因此，我在3月17日去探访了“小木屋”。

sentences.en: This is the day after
sentences.zh: 这是在第二天

sentences.en: Gavin Newsom, California's governor, has ordered the state's bars and restaurants to close.
sentences.zh: 加州州长加文·纽森下令该州酒吧和餐馆关闭的第二天。

sentences.en: So, so, yeah, why don't we just, do you want to record, by the way?
sentences.zh: 所以，所以，对啊，我们要不，顺便问一下，你想录音吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And when I get there, I find the bar's owner, Luenda Kachingue.
sentences.zh: 当我到达那里时，我找到了酒吧的老板路恩达·卡辛格。

sentences.en: Everyone calls him Pancho.
sentences.zh: 大家都叫他潘奇奥（Pancho）。

sentences.en: And he's packing up the bar's booze and basically is in the early hours of trying to figure out what to do with his bar.
sentences.zh: 他正在打包酒吧的酒水，基本上正处于试图弄清楚如何处理他的酒吧的最初几个小时。

sentences.en: And it's a moment of enormous uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满巨大不确定性的时刻。

sentences.en: I think the way that I've been processing it is, what can we do to stay open in some capacity, right?
sentences.zh: 我想我消化这件事的方式是，我们能做些什么来以某种形式保持营业，对吧？

sentences.en: And so you guys are going to pursue this.
sentences.zh: 所以你们打算继续这样。

sentences.en: You're going to do the, you're going to do the takeout.
sentences.zh: 你们要搞，你们要搞外卖。

sentences.en: We're going to try.
sentences.zh: 我们会试试的。

sentences.en: So at this point, he's thinking of moving to takeout.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，他正在考虑转做外卖。

sentences.en: And it's pretty much the only option available for bars and restaurants besides shutting down.
sentences.zh: 除了关门大吉，这几乎是酒吧和餐馆唯一可用的选择了。

sentences.en: We're going to see what it looks like, what it entails.
sentences.zh: 我们要看看它是什么样子的，它需要什么。

sentences.en: I have no clue still, right?
sentences.zh: 我依然毫无头绪，对吧？

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 然后

sentences.en: I'm like, well, what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 我就在想，那会是什么样子？

sentences.en: I'm curious what you're thinking at this point about whether Pancho's going to be able to pull this off.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你当时在想什么，潘奇奥是否能成功挺过去。

sentences.en: Well, I'll say that when I first met Pancho, he actually struck me as sounding pretty relaxed about everything that was going on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我要说的是，当我第一次见到潘奇奥时，他给我的印象其实是对发生的一切显得相当放松。

sentences.en: And I didn't really know him.
sentences.zh: 我当时其实并不了解他。

sentences.en: But as I learned his story, I got the sense that this is a guy who really has had to figure out how to deal.
sentences.zh: 但随着我了解了他的故事，我有一种感觉，这家伙真的是不得不学会如何去应对各种状况。

sentences.en: Uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，是的。

sentences.en: So I was born in Chegutu.
sentences.zh: 所以我出生在切古图。

sentences.en: And that's basically, um...
sentences.zh: 基本上就是，嗯……

sentences.en: Pancho grew up in the 1980s in a rural village in Zimbabwe.
sentences.zh: 潘奇奥在20世纪80年代津巴布韦的一个乡村长大。

sentences.en: And he was the youngest of 13 kids.
sentences.zh: 他是13个孩子中最小的一个。

sentences.en: And when he was 10 years old, his dad, who was an academic, got a job at the University of Iowa.
sentences.zh: 在他10岁的时候，他的父亲是一名学者，在爱荷华大学找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: His siblings were much older than him.
sentences.zh: 他的兄弟姐妹比他大得多。

sentences.en: And he traveled alone with his parents across the world to Iowa.
sentences.zh: 他独自和父母一起跨越大半个地球来到爱荷华。

sentences.en: So we get there, and we are the only Black family there, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们到了那里，我们是那里唯一的黑人家庭，对吧？

sentences.en: And people would be like, you talk funny, right?
sentences.zh: 人们会说，你说话挺逗的，对吧？

sentences.en: And they're like, why do you talk funny, right?
sentences.zh: 他们会说，你为什么说话这么逗，对吧？

sentences.en: And I'm just like, all these things, like, where I was so unsure of myself.
sentences.zh: 而我当时就觉得，所有这些事情，我都太缺乏自信了。

sentences.en: Then at 14 years old, something pretty drastic happened.
sentences.zh: 然后在我14岁的时候，发生了一件相当剧烈的事情。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 什么事？

sentences.en: Um, at that point in time, there was some sort of dysfunction that was happening in the family, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时家里发生了一些不正常的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: That, to this day, I still have no clue what happened.
sentences.zh: 以至于直到今天，我仍然完全不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: So when he was 14, his mother came to him rather suddenly one afternoon and said,
sentences.zh: 所以在他14岁时，一天下午，他母亲有些突然地走到他面前说：

sentences.en: I'm going back to Zimbabwe, and I don't want you to see your father anymore.
sentences.zh: 我要回津巴布韦了，我不想让你再见你父亲了。

sentences.en: We're splitting up.
sentences.zh: 我们要分居了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But I have rented an apartment for you, paid the rent for a few months, and here's some spending money, and you're going to live on your own.
sentences.zh: 但我已经为你租了一间公寓，房租付了几个月，这里有一些零花钱，你要自己一个人生活了。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧。

sentences.en: And just like, I packed your stuff.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我把你的东西打包好了。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was already set up, right.
sentences.zh: 是的，一切都安排好了，对吧。

sentences.en: So it was kind of, well, surreal for one, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这有点，嗯，首先挺超现实的，对吧？

sentences.en: Uh, and the way that I was like, wait, what happened?
sentences.zh: 呃，我的反应就像是，等等，发生什么了？

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Suddenly, you know, he was a 14-year-old kid living on his own.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你知道的，他成了一个独自生活的14岁小孩。

sentences.en: How were you doing?
sentences.zh: 你当时过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Were you going to get groceries or takeout?
sentences.zh: 你是去买杂货还是买外卖？

sentences.en: What were you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么？

sentences.en: No, I had like two or three dishes that I knew how to make.
sentences.zh: 不，我大概有两三道我会做的菜。

sentences.en: Like, I know, like, pasta and eggs.
sentences.zh: 比如，我知道，像意大利面和鸡蛋。

sentences.en: That's like my go-to, right?
sentences.zh: 那就像是我的拿手菜，对吧？

sentences.en: And like, the best peanut butter sandwiches ever.
sentences.zh: 还有史上最好吃的花生酱三明治。

sentences.en: So that was just it.
sentences.zh: 那就这样了。

sentences.en: And then like, whatever we had at school, like whatever school lunches that were happening,
sentences.zh: 然后像我们在学校吃的午餐，不管学校提供什么午餐，

sentences.en: I would do like the frozen dinners.
sentences.zh: 我就会吃那种冷冻晚餐。

sentences.en: Like, I learned how to budget really early on.
sentences.zh: 就像，我很早就学会了如何做预算。

sentences.en: I was like, I'm going to budget.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，我要做预算。

sentences.en: And just be like, what can I eat that can actually last me a long time, right?
sentences.zh: 然后就会想，我吃什么才能真正维持很久呢，对吧？

sentences.en: So he would wake up in the morning alone as a 14-year-old in an apartment and make himself breakfast, dress himself, wash his clothes, go to school.
sentences.zh: 所以他作为一个14岁的孩子，早上独自醒来在一间公寓里，给自己做早餐，穿衣，洗衣服，去上学。

sentences.en: And he just did that.
sentences.zh: 他就是那样做的。

sentences.en: He was a kid acting as an adult.
sentences.zh: 他是一个扮演着成年人角色的孩子。

sentences.en: But at night, as other kids were going home to their families, he was going home alone to his apartment.
sentences.zh: 但到了晚上，当其他孩子回家与家人团聚时，他却独自一人回到自己的公寓。

sentences.en: I mean, like, there's definitely a lot of loneliness, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里面绝对有很多孤独感，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, like, basically, it was hard to sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上，晚上很难入睡。

sentences.en: So I'd go like on these long night walks.
sentences.zh: 所以我就会去进行这些长途的夜间漫步。

sentences.en: It's like thinking about the future, really, right?
sentences.zh: 真的就像是在思考未来，对吧？

sentences.en: I used to call them the future walks, right?
sentences.zh: 我过去常把它们叫做未来漫步，对吧？

sentences.en: And just being like, well, what are the things that you want to do?
sentences.zh: 然后就会想，嗯，你想做的事情是什么？

sentences.en: Or like, the thought that I would always have would just be, I'm like, well, it can't get any worse.
sentences.zh: 或者说，我脑子里总是会闪过这样一个想法，我就想，嗯，情况不可能更糟了。

sentences.en: I'm like, this is where you're at now.
sentences.zh: 我就想，这就是你现在的处境。

sentences.en: And it can only go up, right?
sentences.zh: 情况只会越来越好，对吧？

sentences.en: And it does go up.
sentences.zh: 情况确实变好了。

sentences.en: Within a few months, he moves in with his best friend's family.
sentences.zh: 几个月内，他搬去和最好的朋友的家人一起住。

sentences.en: And, you know, he finishes high school, goes to college in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他完成了高中学业，去明尼苏达州上大学。

sentences.en: Then he moves to the Bay Area, becomes a bartender.
sentences.zh: 然后他搬到湾区，成了一名酒保。

sentences.en: And a few years after that, he decides to go it on his own.
sentences.zh: 几年后，他决定自己单干。

sentences.en: And he looks across the Bay, where rents are cheaper.
sentences.zh: 他把目光投向了海湾对岸，那里的租金更便宜。

sentences.en: And he finds this old Hawaiian barbecue joint with orange carpets.
sentences.zh: 他找到了这家铺着橙色地毯的夏威夷老式烧烤店。

sentences.en: And he turns it into the hatch.
sentences.zh: 他把它变成了“小木屋”。

sentences.en: And very quickly, Pancho found success.
sentences.zh: 很快，潘奇奥就取得了成功。

sentences.en: And when you say success, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 当你说成功时，你指的是什么？

sentences.en: They were busy from the outset, essentially.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们从一开始生意就很忙碌。

sentences.en: He said that, you know, in his first months, he was serving drinks in red Solo cups.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，在最初的几个月里，他用红色塑料Solo杯倒饮料。

sentences.en: And he was sleeping upstairs on a couch, but the place was pretty packed.
sentences.zh: 他睡在楼上的沙发上，但店里相当拥挤。

sentences.en: So fast forward to this past spring, the hatch is employing 17 people.
sentences.zh: 时间快进到今年春天，“小木屋”雇佣了17名员工。

sentences.en: And then the shutdown happens.
sentences.zh: 然后停业发生了。

sentences.en: And Pancho has to lay most of them off.
sentences.zh: 潘奇奥不得不解雇了他们中的大多数人。

sentences.en: And those employees are waiting to see if Pancho can keep the bar alive, survive the shutdown, and ultimately bring them back.
sentences.zh: 这些员工都在等待，看潘奇奥能否让酒吧维持下去、在停业中存活下来，并最终把他们召回。

sentences.en: And what do you know about these people who were let go?
sentences.zh: 关于这些被解雇的人，你了解多少？

sentences.en: So, essentially, at the hatch, like most bars, there is a front of the house and a back of the house.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，在“小木屋”，就像大多数酒吧一样，分为前厅和后厨。

sentences.en: And the front of the house are the bartenders who were musicians and artists and photographers.
sentences.zh: 前厅是酒保，他们是音乐家、艺术家和摄影师。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're mostly in their 20s and 30s.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们大多在20多岁和30多岁。

sentences.en: And they're trying to make rent and, you know, some spending money to go out with their friends.
sentences.zh: 他们努力挣钱付房租，你知道的，还有和朋友出去玩的零花钱。

sentences.en: And then there was the back of the house.
sentences.zh: 然后是后厨。

sentences.en: And these are people in their 50s who are trying to survive and trying to support children.
sentences.zh: 这些人都在50多岁，努力谋生并养育孩子。

sentences.en: So, I wanted to know what this shutdown would be like for people on both sides.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想知道这次停业对双方的人来说会是什么样的。

sentences.en: And so, in early April, with the help of a translator, I started talking to Maria.
sentences.zh: 因此，在4月初，在一位翻译的帮助下，我开始和玛丽亚交谈。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Estamos aquí, please.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里，请吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Hola, Maria.
sentences.zh: 你好，玛丽亚。

sentences.en: Hola.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: She's someone I had never seen before at the hatch because she would come in at the crack of dawn to, you know, scrub the floors and clean the tables where my friends and I drink.
sentences.zh: 她是我以前在“小木屋”从未见过的人，因为她会在清晨破晓时分来，你知道的，擦洗地板，清理我和朋友们喝酒的桌子。

sentences.en: And what did you learn about her?
sentences.zh: 你对她有什么了解？

sentences.en: Maria is 55 years old, and she is from the Mexican state of Michoacan.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚今年55岁，她来自墨西哥米却肯州。

sentences.en: And in the late 1990s, her husband crosses into the United States without documents.
sentences.zh: 大约在20世纪90年代末，她的丈夫在没有合法证件的情况下偷偷进入了美国。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, she follows.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她也跟了过去。

sentences.en: So, her and her husband and Maria's young stepdaughter all kind of start this new life in America.
sentences.zh: 于是，她、丈夫还有玛丽亚年幼的继女，开始在美国开启了这样一种新生活。

sentences.en: And, you know, working on fake documents that cost about 20 bucks.

sentences.en: But she's too afraid to apply for it because she figures it's going to put her on a liSt.

sentences.zh: 为了这个，她甚至不得不停止去进行理疗。

sentences.zh: 但她最大的担忧是几周后就该交的房租。

sentences.en: So, she's not sure what she's going to do?

sentences.zh: 所以，她一直在说她有一点积蓄，那是她留给女儿的毕业基金。

sentences.en: Really, the only savings at this point that she has is this $800 that she's been saving as a graduation gift for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 说实话，她现在仅有的积蓄就是这800美元，这是她一直为女儿攒下的毕业礼物。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to spend it, but she says she has no choice.
sentences.zh: 她不想花这笔钱，但她说她别无选择。

sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，面对现在的所有情况，你最担心的是什么？

sentences.en: ¿Y qué es lo que estás sintiendo ahora?
sentences.zh: 你现在心里是什么感觉？

sentences.zh: 而且经济问题是我最担心的。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 好的，她说她感到非常难过，主要是因为经济问题而忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: She's very worried.

sentences.en: I understand.

sentences.en: She's much less worried about getting sick from the coronavirus than she is about making money and paying a rent.

sentences.zh: 另一个人是亚贝尔·奥尔森。

sentences.zh: 他是一个34岁的调酒师，简直就是你在Hatch这种地方会期望看到的标准调酒师形象。

sentences.en: He's got a bushy mustache.
sentences.zh: 他留着浓密的胡须。

sentences.en: He wears vintage t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 穿着复古T恤。

sentences.en: He has lots of tattoos he can't explain.
sentences.zh: 身上有很多连他自己也解释不清来源的纹身。

sentences.en: Abel started working at the Hatch last fall.
sentences.zh: 亚贝尔去年秋天开始在Hatch工作。

sentences.en: He got along with the staff, loved the customers.
sentences.zh: 他和员工们相处得很好，也很喜欢这里的顾客。

sentences.en: He was doing DJ nights upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他还在楼上做过DJ之夜的活动。

sentences.en: So, it turns out that the shutdown came at a really bad time for Abel.
sentences.zh: 所以事实证明，酒吧停业对亚贝尔来说真不是时候。

sentences.en: He just went on a big grocery run.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚去大采购了一番。

sentences.en: He, you know, just paid off an overdue $270 phone bill, and essentially he tells me he's got about $20 in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他刚付清了一笔270美元逾期的电话费，他告诉我，基本上他口袋里现在就剩20美元左右了。

sentences.en: I live, you know, check to check.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我向来是拿一份薪水过日子。

sentences.en: I live tip to tip as a bartender.
sentences.zh: 作为一名调酒师，我是靠着每一笔小费过日子的。

sentences.en: So, when, you know, I have $20 in my pocket, that is, you know, could be kind of a scary thing, but it's a temporary thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，当我口袋里只有20美元时，这可能会让人觉得有点可怕，但这只是暂时的。

sentences.en: So, now he's hunkered down and quarantined with his girlfriend, who's out of work as a bud tender at a weed dispensary in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在他和女朋友一起在旧金山居家隔离，他的女朋友在一家大麻店里当大麻零售店员，现在也失业了。

sentences.en: Honestly, and we're not spending a dime.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我们现在一分钱都不花。

sentences.en: You know, I like, we both kind of canceled all of our subscription services, and besides paying bills and food, we're, you know, spending $0, so.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们俩取消了所有订阅服务，除了付账单和买食物外，你知道的，我们现在的花销是0美元，所以。

sentences.en: But these are circumstances that are somewhat familiar to Abel.
sentences.zh: 但这些情况对亚贝尔来说并不算陌生。

sentences.en: He spent much of his childhood in Portland with a single mom who was sometimes out of work.
sentences.zh: 他的童年大部分时间是在波特兰度过的，由一位单亲妈妈抚养大，母亲有时也会失业。

sentences.en: And he also lost his job as a bartender before, when he was in his 20s, and kind of was familiar with the unemployment process.
sentences.zh: 在他20多岁时，他也曾失去过调酒师的工作，所以对失业申领流程算是门清。

sentences.en: And, you know, very obnoxious.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，非常讨厌这些繁文缛节。

sentences.en: So, and I was, you know, fully prepared for that kind of bureaucracy again.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我已经完全做好了再次面对那种官僚作风的心理准备。

sentences.en: So, the day after the lockdown began, he immediately applied for funds.
sentences.zh: 于是，封锁开始的第二天，他立刻就去申请了资金补助。

sentences.en: He applied for government assistance.
sentences.zh: 他申请了政府援助。

sentences.en: He applied for this bartender fund.
sentences.zh: 他申请了这个调酒师救助基金。

sentences.en: He basically fanned out and looked for every source of money that he could get.
sentences.zh: 他基本上广撒网，寻找所有能弄到钱的渠道。

sentences.en: That's the biggest problem right now is, you know, just waiting for these things to come through and, you know, going food shopping and trying to kill boredom.
sentences.zh: 现在最大的问题就是，你知道的，只能干等这些救济批下来，然后去买买菜，尽量打发无聊的时间。

sentences.en: And that's kind of about it.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样了。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 保重身体，老弟。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, as of early April, Abel is waiting to see if he's going to get government assistance.
sentences.zh: 因此，到4月初时，亚贝尔还在等待政府援助是否能批下来。

sentences.en: He's applied for it.
sentences.zh: 他已经提交了申请。

sentences.en: Maria is not eligible for any of that assistance and afraid to seek the benefits she could get from California.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚则不符合任何援助的资格，而且害怕去争取她本可以从加州获得的那部分福利。

sentences.en: And so, she's running out of money.
sentences.zh: 所以，她的钱快花光了。

sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.zh: 嘿，潘乔。

sentences.zh: 嘿，你来啦。

sentences.en: How's it going, man?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样，老兄？

sentences.zh: 因此，当我在4月份采访亚贝尔和玛丽亚时，我也联系了潘乔，想看看外卖业务进展如何。

sentences.en: I started the takeout delivery service, which was building it from scratch, right?
sentences.zh: 我开展了外卖配送服务，这完全是从零开始搭建的，对吧？

sentences.en: When you did, you said you did deliveries yesterday or today?
sentences.zh: 你这么做的时候，你说是昨天还是今天开始送外卖的？

sentences.en: Yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天。

sentences.en: Yeah, I did deliveries yesterday.
sentences.zh: 对，我昨天开始送外卖了。

sentences.en: And how many did you actually do?
sentences.zh: 那你实际上送了多少单？

sentences.en: I did one delivery.
sentences.zh: 我送了一单。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, takeout is not going well.
sentences.zh: 所以，外卖业务并不顺利。

sentences.en: In the first week, the hatch had nine orders, and I was one of them.
sentences.zh: 第一周里，Hatch接了九单，而我就是其中一位顾客。

sentences.en: So, that brought in $369 in the first week.
sentences.zh: 所以第一周总共带来了369美元的收入。

sentences.en: And that obviously wasn't going to be enough to help the business survive.
sentences.zh: 显然，这根本不足以帮助企业生存下去。

sentences.en: And on top of that, he had, you know, multiple other complications.
sentences.zh: 最要命的是，你知道的，他还面临着其他种种棘手的问题。

sentences.en: Yelp, bit of a setback, for sure.
sentences.zh: Yelp账号出了状况，这绝对是个不小的打击。

sentences.en: The fact that he got locked out of the Hatch's Yelp account because of an overdue advertising bill.
sentences.zh: 因为一笔广告费逾期未付，他被锁在了Hatch的Yelp账号外面。

sentences.en: Wait, so they blocked all your ads?
sentences.zh: 等等，所以他们把你的广告全封了？

sentences.en: Can you clarify that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: It says that we have to pay the bill that we need to pay.
sentences.zh: 上面说我们必须把欠的账单给结清才行。

sentences.en: So, you know, the number one platform that people use, we can't advertise that we're open when we're doing deliveries and takeout on it because they blocked us out.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，人们最常用的那个平台，我们在上面做外卖和配送时却无法宣传我们开业了，因为他们把我们屏蔽在外了。

sentences.en: And why is that important?
sentences.zh: 这为什么很重要？

sentences.en: It was important because without Yelp, in some ways, it was very difficult for them to tell their customers that they were even doing takeout now.
sentences.zh: 这很关键，因为没有了Yelp，在某种程度上，他们很难让顾客知道他们现在其实还在做外卖。

sentences.en: Instead, I would watch the Hatch's Instagram account post these increasingly desperate pitches to get people to come in.
sentences.zh: 相反，我只能看着Hatch的Instagram账号不断发布那些日益绝望的贴文，求大家来店里买点东西。

sentences.en: One of the Instagram posts I remember is just Robin waiting bored by the phone, being like, please call me.
sentences.zh: 我记得其中有一条Instagram贴文是罗宾百无聊赖地守着电话，配文仿佛在说：求求了，给我打电话吧。

sentences.en: But people weren't?
sentences.zh: 但有人打吗？

sentences.en: No, obviously not.
sentences.zh: 没有，显然没有。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a really difficult start for the takeout business.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，外卖业务的开局真的是举步维艰。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，他还背负着8000多美元的房租债务。

sentences.en: And he had no money coming in.
sentences.zh: 然而他却没有任何收入来源。

sentences.en: And at this point, what are his options?
sentences.zh: 到了这个地步，他还有什么选择呢？

sentences.zh: 大约就在那个时候，国会通过了一项3490亿美元的小企业贷款打包法案，正是为了像潘乔这样的人设立的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: PPP.
sentences.zh: 薪资保护计划（PPP）。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是。

sentences.en: So these are essentially forgivable small business loans that are designed to help small business
sentences.zh: 所以这本质上是可以免除的小企业贷款，旨在帮助像潘乔这样处境的小企业

sentences.en: owners, just like Poncho, who are in this situation to get a lifeline and keep their businesses alive and keep paying their employees.
sentences.zh: 主获得一根救命稻草，维持企业存续，并继续给员工发工资。

sentences.en: So immediately, I was like, well, I'm going to jump on this because I suspected everybody would want to jump in on it.
sentences.zh: 所以我立刻就想，好吧，我要赶紧申请，因为我猜所有人都会想去抢这个名额。

sentences.en: Immediately, Poncho applies for one of these loans through Chase Bank.
sentences.zh: 潘乔立刻通过大通银行申请了其中一笔贷款。

sentences.en: So I put in the information and they're like, great, good job.
sentences.zh: 于是我输入了信息，然后他们说：太棒了，干得好。

sentences.en: They go, we'll send you a confirmation email.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们会发一封确认邮件给你。

sentences.en: Email never showed up.
sentences.zh: 结果邮件压根没影。

sentences.en: And it's just completely a Kafka-esque experience.
sentences.zh: 这完全就是一种卡夫卡式的荒诞经历。

sentences.en: And then five days later, I got another email and they're going, you can apply now.
sentences.zh: 结果五天后，我收到了另一封邮件，他们说：你现在可以申请了。

sentences.en: And I was like, I'm pretty sure I did.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，我确信我已经申请过了啊。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure I already applied.
sentences.zh: 我确信我之前已经申请过了。

sentences.en: Poncho understood that he was competing against literally hundreds of thousands of other small business owners to get this money.
sentences.zh: 潘乔明白，为了争取到这笔资金，他正在与成百上千的其他小企业主进行激烈的竞争。

sentences.en: Then we were like in panic mode.
sentences.zh: 当时我们简直陷入了恐慌状态。

sentences.en: And then Chase was like, sorry, you're not eligible at this time to get a loan.
sentences.zh: 然后大通银行却说：抱歉，你目前不符合获得贷款的资格。

sentences.en: You know, so I'm like, oh, my God.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.zh: 真是个烂摊子。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是啊。

sentences.zh: 那你觉得他此刻的心情怎么样？

sentences.en: Because this is a pretty grim situation.
sentences.zh: 因为这确实是个相当严峻的处境。

sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: This is a real crossroads for the Hatch and for Poncho.

sentences.en: So Jack, it has now been six months since you started following Poncho and the staff of The Hatch.
sentences.zh: 所以，杰克，你追踪报道潘趣和The Hatch的员工已经有六个月了。

sentences.en: Ultimately, what did this experience tell you about what it takes to keep a small business alive right now?
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这段经历让你明白了现在要维持一家小企业需要付出什么吗？

sentences.en: I think what it takes is a true reopening of the economy.
sentences.zh: 我认为需要的真正经济的重新开放。

sentences.en: And I think it's pretty clear at this point that that isn't going to happen anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这一点很清楚，那就是这在短期内不会发生。

sentences.en: And so that means that a place like The Hatch is left teetering on the edge.
sentences.zh: 这意味着像The Hatch这样的地方正处于悬崖边缘摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: And that also means that people who rely on The Hatch to survive, you know, its employees are also teetering.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着那些依赖The Hatch生存的人，你知道，它的员工们也同样在摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: And these are people who were already on the edge.
sentences.zh: 这些人本来就已经处在边缘了。

sentences.en: These are people who can't work from home.
sentences.zh: 这些人是无法在家办公的。

sentences.en: These are hourly workers who don't have many, if any savings.
sentences.zh: 这些人是按小时计酬的工人，没有什么积蓄，如果有的话也是微乎其微。

sentences.en: And so it's going to remain an important question of what happens to these people over the next months and even years.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些人未来几个月甚至几年会怎么样，仍将是一个重要的问题。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to remember that, you know, this is the story of my neighborhood bar, but it's also the story of your neighborhood bar.
sentences.zh: 我认为重要的是要记住，你知道，这是我社区酒吧的故事，但它也是你社区酒吧的故事。

sentences.en: This is the story of everyone's favorite bar or restaurant.
sentences.zh: 这是每个人最喜欢的酒吧或餐厅的故事。

sentences.en: And remember that before the pandemic, The Hatch was successful.
sentences.zh: 还要记住，在大流行之前，The Hatch是成功的。

sentences.en: I mean, this was a place that was, you know, pretty full just about every night of the week.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一个，你知道，基本上每周七天每天晚上都座无虚席的地方。

sentences.en: And now Poncho is scraping to survive, you know, for the sake of The Hatch and for the sake of his employees.
sentences.zh: 而现在潘趣为了维持生计在苦苦挣扎，你知道，为了The Hatch，也为了他的员工。

sentences.en: And yet he's finding that there's really only so much he can do.
sentences.zh: 然而他发现自己能做的事其实真的很有限。

sentences.en: Jack, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 杰克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: So I'm walking down 15th Street.
sentences.zh: 所以我正沿着15号街走着。

sentences.en: It is Labor Day weekend in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 这是奥克兰的劳动节周末。

sentences.en: And we're just coming up to The Hatch.
sentences.zh: 我们马上就要到The Hatch了。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: But I have learned to have no expectations in 2020.
sentences.zh: 但我学会在2020年不抱任何期望。

sentences.en: Like, how could you predict there's going to be wildfires?
sentences.zh: 就像，你怎么能预测会发生野火呢？

sentences.en: You know, with the wildfire.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有野火。

sentences.en: I mean, we had to shut down again yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们昨天不得不再次关门。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Two days ago.
sentences.zh: 两天前。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because of the smoke, the air quality.
sentences.zh: 因为烟雾，空气质量。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was in the red.
sentences.zh: 对，空气质量指数达到红色预警了。

sentences.en: So anytime he hits orange, we just ended up just shutting down.
sentences.zh: 所以只要它一达到橙色，我们最终就会直接关门。

sentences.en: So that means like you've now, you've now got a business that is required to be outside and you can't be outside, essentially.
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着，你现在经营着一家被要求在户外营业却基本上无法在户外营业的企业。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Pretty much.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: You can't be inside because of a deadly virus and then you can't be outside because of deadly smoke.
sentences.zh: 你不能因为致命的病毒在室内营业，然后又不能因为致命的烟雾在室外营业。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.zh: 距离他上一次发烧已经过去72小时以上了。

sentences.zh: 氧气水平，包括动态血氧饱和度以及他的呼吸做功，全都是正常的。

sentences.zh: 周一下午，总统的主治医师肖恩·康利授权总统

sentences.en: Trump to leave Walter Reed Medical Center after four days of treatment and return to the White House.

sentences.en: and most importantly, his clinical status, support the president's safe return home, where he'll be surrounded by world-class medical care, 24-7.

sentences.en: We're going back.

sentences.zh: 作为你们的领导人，我不得不这么做。

sentences.en: I knew there's danger to it, but I had to do it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这有危险，但我必须这么做。

sentences.en: I stood out front.
sentences.zh: 我站在最前面。

sentences.zh: 我带头了。

sentences.en: Nobody that's a leader would not do what I did.
sentences.zh: 任何称职的领导人都会做我所做的事。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the outbreak within the White House continued to spread.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，白宫内部的疫情仍在继续蔓延。

sentences.en: On Monday, White House Press Secretary Kayleigh McEnany and two of her deputies also tested positive for the virus.
sentences.zh: 周一，白宫新闻秘书凯莉·麦肯纳尼和她的两名副手病毒检测也呈阳性。
